text.p: Tenneco Inc said Friday it has refinanced $3.53 billion in debt as part of a restructuring of the company.

The company said it has made tender and exchange offers, as well as consent solicitations, for $1.58 billion principal amount of debt issued by the company and two units, Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co and Tenneco Credit Corp.

The company also said a new entity, initially called New Tenneco Inc, will exchange as much as $1.95 billion in principal amount of new notes and debentures for any and all of the $1.95 billion principal amount of notes and debentures outstanding
Under the reorganization, Tenneco's automotive parts, packaging and administrative services businesses will be spun off to common shareholders as New Tenneco Inc, which will be renamed Tenneco Inc.
Each tender and exchange offer is set to expire at 1700 EST on December 10.

Tenneco's shipbuilding business will be spun off to common shareholders as Newport News Shipbuilding Inc and Tenneco's remaining energy business will be merged with a subsidiary of El Paso Natural Gas Co.

As part of the debt realignment plan, Tenneco will defease and/or redeem at maturity $277.6 million principal amount of certain notes and the medium term notes of the two subsidiaries, Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co and Tenneco Credit Corp.
